name: warhorse-cyberattack
note: Breaking lane (lane A), legal and hacking rule: neutral, studio's own words only, our bed, official footage. Warhorse Studios on X, 27 Oct: 'We're sorry to share that Warhorse Studios has been hit by a cyberattack. We're working with cybersecurity specialists to secure our systems and understand the full extent of what happened.' First reports Eurogamer.de 11:26Z, PC Gamer 11:55Z. Footage: KCD2 CGI trailer only (Steam 1771300; the launch, story and Royal Edition trailers are letterboxed to about 816 rows), credited as stand-in; combat and knife shots left out.
